tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one full-body visual-novel sprite of Sangonomiya Kokomi expressing desire-1, using only the supplied approved neutral as image reference. Preserve identity, face, skin tone, hair, eyes, costume, accessories, colors and rendering. Preserve her petite Medium Female proportions, pink-and-blue hair, fin-like hair ornaments and blue-violet costume. Give this emotion its own expressive full-body acting, genuinely varying leg positions, stance, body angle and gestures rather than locking the neutral pose: clearly legible yearning affection, flushed cheeks, parted lips, raised inner brows and an intent hopeful gaze, a slight forward lean and one foot subtly ahead, one hand near the heart and the other relaxed; tasteful and fully clothed. Heart eyes, hearts in eyes: both eyes visibly open; retain the original iris colors, outlines, shading and a visible colored border, with one solid pale blue heart-shaped pupil centered in each iris. Hearts are pupils, not highlights or floating symbols. Hands should be simple and readable; each visible hand has one anatomically correct thumb and four fingers connected to one palm and wrist. Do not force hidden digits into view. Exactly two coherent legs and feet; varied bends, steps, stances and angles are welcome. Keep the complete silhouette including hair, headwear, accessories, hands and shoes visible, roughly 2–4% top and bottom padding, without lengthening the body. True transparent background. No scenery, text, UI, weapons, companions, floating effects or ground shadow.
